svg.aria-label: The Filament repositories. The main chain runs from the standard, filament-specification, to the compiler, filament-spec-language, then filament-contract-ir, filament-contract-codegen and filament-contract-runtime. filament-spec-language also feeds filament-protocol, and filament-contract-ir feeds filament-analyze. filament-observation feeds filament-protocol and filament-mltl. Above the chain, filament-driver runs it, filament-integration tests it and filament-verification plans verification. Below it, shared libraries used throughout: filament-eval, filament-exact, filament-semantic-value, filament-walk, quire-canonical and filament-verification-contracts.
